concepts.gloss_en: poverty (the abstract state/condition of being poor)

members.note: abstract noun denoting the condition of poverty

concepts.gloss_en: poor person / the poor one (concrete: a pauper, e.g. Ark of the Covenant as בחינת עני)

members.note: concrete referent — a poor person (בחינת עני, עניה ודלה); distinct head from the abstract state עניות

notes: Different concepts: abstract state (poverty) vs. the concrete poor person. Per rule 4, a state/quality is not the same as the entity possessing it. Kept separate (under-merge preferred).
